subject: [PATCH] mm/vmscan: reclaim every zone in per-node proactive reclaim

reviews.author: Xueyuan Chen
reviews.summary: Reviewer agreed that including all zones makes sense for per-node proactive reclaim, as it is not serving an allocation, and noted that existing GFP context restrictions and folio isolation checks remain in place.
reviews.raw_body:
Including all zones makes sense here, since per-node proactive reclaim
is not serving an allocation. The existing GFP context restrictions
and folio isolation checks remain in place.

Reviewed-by: Xueyuan Chen <xueyuan.chen21@gmail.com>

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewer acknowledged the patch as sensible, provided an Acked-by tag, and made a lighthearted comment about it being 'the review of the ages'.
reviews.raw_body:
Seems sensible to me, and since it's become the review of the ages (TM) let's

Acked-by: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM) <ljs@kernel.org>

reviews.author: Gregory Price (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the current implementation of user_proactive_reclaim() limits proactive reclaim to ZONE_NORMAL, agreed to restructure in v2 to scan every zone.
reviews.raw_body:
1 line change
20 acks

This is the way.

~Gregory

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch modifies the per-node proactive reclaim function to scan every zone, not just ZONE_NORMAL, in order to reclaim movable memory as well. This addresses a problem where nodes with only movable memory were not being reclaimed properly. The approach taken is to change the `reclaim_idx` field of the `scan_control` structure to always set it to the maximum number of zones, allowing all zones to be scanned.

reviews.author: Balbir Singh
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch's proactive reclaim may violate the contract for cgroups reclaim interface by setting .may_writepage and .may_unmap to 1, which could conflict with node zone reclaim constraints.
sentiment_signals: violation of default node reclaim parameters
reviews.raw_body:
:)

I was looking at making may_writepage and may_unmap align with the
constraints of node zone reclaim, .may_writepage = !!(node_reclaim_mode & RECLAIM_WRITE),
and .may_unmap = !!(node_reclaim_mode & RECLAIM_UNMAP), which may
violate the contract for proactive reclaim. Proactive reclaim itself
tries to be compatible with cgroups reclaim interface, so it sets these
values to 1. I still feel it is a violation of default node reclaim
parameters, but not sure if it needs to be fixed up.

Balbir
